title: Java Fullstack Developer (Angular)
description:
About You

You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
  • Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, CloudWatch, and Bedrock.
  • Experience using MyBatis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
  • 2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of RxJS and Observables.
  • Familiarity with frontend monolith architectures and modern client-side frameworks.
  • Advanced knowledge of Git and version control best practices.
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using RxJS and Observables.
  • Implement and manage data persistence using PostgreSQL, MyBatis, Liquibase, and Redis.
  • Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, CloudWatch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
  • Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.


Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

title: Líder técnico
description:
Qualificações

  • Superior em Ciência da Computação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas
  • Habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita
  • Habilidades avançadas de análise e resolução de problemas

Responsabilidades

  • Ser comprometido e engajado na proposição e evolução das soluções tanto do ponto de vista técnico, do negócio e da experiência oferecida ao usuário
  • Priorizar soluções mais genéricas e reutilizáveis ao invés de focar em necessidades específicas
  • Acompanhar métricas do time e das soluções apoiando na melhoria contínua
  • Ter boa capacidade de interação e comunicação com pessoas técnicas e não técnicas
  • Atuar como agente motivador da equipe através do exemplo e do compartilhamento de conhecimentos
  • Participar do desenvolvimento e formação de novos líderes técnicos
  • Fazer a ligação entre o time técnico e de negócio

Conhecimentos necessários

  • Arquitetura baseada em micro serviços
  • Metodologias Ágeis de Projetos (Scrum / Kanban)
  • Java
  • Stack Spring
  • Testes Unitários e de Integração
  • Git e Gitflow
  • Containers baseados Docker
  • Jenkins
  • AWS
  • API Gateway
  • Lambda
  • Fargate
  • ECS, RDS, SQS, SNS
  • Secrets Manager
  • Elasticache (Redis)
  • SOLID
  • Clean Architecture

Desejáveis

  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações móveis
  • Desenvolvimento baseado em event sourcing
  • Play Framework
  • Conhecimento em NodeJS/Python/Golang/Groovy
  • Terraform

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: ServiceNow Developer with Strategic Portfolio Management(SPM) & ITSM
description:
Title: ServiceNow Developer with Strategic Portfolio Management(SPM) & ITSM

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract

Job Specific Responsibilities:

● Have the ability to assist requesters in refining business requirement details to ensure the customers will be receiving functionality requested.

● Gain knowledge of our overall ServiceNow implementation to understand and identify cross platform impacts of changes or enhancements being requested.

● Design, develop, and implement SPM solutions including workflows, catalog items, workspaces, and integrations to meet complex business requirements

● Configure and customize the ServiceNow platform using javascript and ServiceNow APIs to extend capabilities and enhance user experience

● Design and implement workflows to support business needs and increase automation

● Develop and configure integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems using integration spokes or custom APIs

● Work within the Agile methodology to develop, build and test alongside other developers to ensure the best product is delivered to requestors in a timely manner

● Work with implementation partners, or internal project teams to Implement new modules as business needs evolve

● Assist with regular ServiceNow version upgrades to ensure we remain compliant and supported by the vendor

Key Skills, Requirements and Competencies:

● Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or a relevant technical field

● At least 3+ years experience working with the ServiceNow platform, specifically in the SPM module, and with good familiarity with ITSM, and the general ServiceNow platform

● Strong understanding of ITIL principles and practices

● Proficiency in JavaScript and ServiceNow API web services

● Proven experience with integrating ServiceNow with other applications

● Excellent analytical and problem solving skills

● Effective communication and interpersonal skills

Thanks

Aatmesh

description:

Location: Remote – Brazil

Contract Type: Service Contract (PJ/Freelancer)

Role Overview:

We are seeking a Software Developer with strong expertise in Javascript and React and proven web programming experience. The ideal candidate is also comfortable working with other programming languages, has advanced coding skills, and in-depth knowledge of modern HTML/CSS.

Responsibilities:

  • Write well-structured, testable, and efficient code following best development practices.
  • Create website layouts and user interfaces using modern HTML/CSS standards.
  • Integrate data from multiple back-end services and databases.

  • Work with other programming languages as required.
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends, applying them to projects.
  • Collaborate with designers to ensure visual design alignment.
  • Preferred: experience with mobile development (iOS/Android) or React Native.

  • Solid experience in Javascript, React, and Node.js.
  • Strong programming skills and in-depth knowledge of modern HTML/CSS.
  • Understanding of web application functionality, including security and best practices.
  • Proven track record in web programming.
  • Knowledge of relational databases, object-oriented programming, and web application development.
  • Problem-solving and creative diagnosis skills.
  • Strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent English (written and spoken).

  • Experience with Web3, MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js).

  • Contractor will work under a service agreement (PJ/Freelancer).

title: Analista de Suporte OSGT Sênior \"#990280\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Fornecer suporte técnico direto aos clientes focados na solução de Comércio Exterior (OSGT - OneSource Global Trade);
  • Utilizar a linguagem PL/SQL como base principal para todas as análises e investigações, criação de scripts para pequenas rotinas de manutenção;
  • Realizar investigações técnicas (debug) em PL/SQL com banco de dados ORACLE;
  • Atuar diretamente no monitoramento e troubleshooting das Integrações entre a OSGT;
  • Prestar atendimento ao cliente via telefone e/ou Teams, solucionando dúvidas e eventuais problemas da versão de forma eficaz;
  • Trabalhar com interação direta com todos os Módulos da OSGT (Importação, Exportação, Regimes Especiais, Drawback, etc);
  • Atuar em conjunto com diferentes departamentos para garantir a integração e funcionamento adequado dos sistemas;
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica detalhada sobre os processos e integrações realizadas;
  • Analisar e documentar toda da análise técnica e funcional realizada para compartilhamento aos times de desenvolvimento.

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência como analista de suporte ao sistema OSGT (ONESOURCE Global Trade), nos módulos de Import, Export, Cambio Import e Cambio Export;
  • Experiência em PL/SQL para suporte técnico.

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

description:
• We are looking for a part-time, remote Support Specialist to evaluate system alerts and initiate deployment of a service technician when necessary. You will work 5 to 10 hours per week performing alert support duties during evenings, weekends, and U.S. holidays .
  • Our U.S. client's software helps heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) contractors capture more customers, convert them into service members, and retain them for life. Homeowners gain an enhanced service experience and ultimately greater peace of mind on the reliability for one of the most expensive assets in a home. Backed by premier venture capital firms, our client's software platform allows contractors to monitor, manage, and optimize their maintenance memberships through advanced sensors, AI-driven diagnostics, and proactive alerts.


Responsibilities

  • Monitor and triage system alerts determining the necessity of dispatching a service technician
  • Perform duties during off hours including evenings, weekends, and U.S. holidays
  • Document alert resolution in trouble ticketing system

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to evaluate data inputs based on an established diagnostic process
  • Strong attention to detail and tracking record for reliability and diligence
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

title: Staff Software Engineer - Busca & Recomendação
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um Staff Software Engineer para atuar como referência técnica no time de busca e recomendação , contexto esse de alta criticidade. Sendo responsável por construir e evoluir soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alto desempenho .

Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução arquitetural , na tomada de decisões tecnológicas , na elevação contínua da qualidade técnica e na condução de iniciativas de alto impacto para o negócio .


O que você vai fazer

  • Atuar como referência técnica do time , guiando decisões arquiteturais e garantindo excelência em engenharia;
  • Projetar, desenvolver e evoluir sistemas de larga escala utilizando Go (Golang) e .NET;
  • Arquitetar e implementar soluções em Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , com foco em automação, escalabilidade, segurança e confiabilidade;
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais , garantindo performance e consistência;
  • Implementar e evoluir práticas de observabilidade , utilizando Datadog, Grafana e ferramentas correlatas;
  • Liderar iniciativas de CI/CD , qualidade de código e engenharia de confiabilidade (SRE);
  • Mentorar engenheiros, promovendo boas práticas, padrões técnicos e crescimento do time .


O que você precisa para a posição no jogo:

  • Experiência com ElasticSearch , incluindo tuning e otimização de motores de busca para e-commerce;
  • Conhecimento em Machine Learning aplicado a relevância e ranking , do motor de busca;
  • Domínio em .NET e/ou Golang;
  • Forte experiência com GCP e infraestrutura em cloud;
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de produtores e consumidores de eventos para Event Streaming (Kafka);
  • Conhecimento em Docker e Kubernetes , incluindo deploy, escalabilidade e operação de aplicações conteinerizadas;
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Vivência com observabilidade (Datadog, Grafana, Kibana);
  • Experiência com CI/CD e práticas modernas de engenharia de software;
  • Noções ou experiência em Ciência de Dados;
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de busca em e-commerce;
  • Vivência com experimentação , métricas e testes A/B para validação de hipóteses e comprovação de conceitos.


O que esperamos do seu perfil

  • Mentalidade de dono , com visão sistêmica e foco em longo prazo;
  • Capacidade de influenciar tecnicamente e elevar a barra do time;
  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e assertiva , inclusive com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Perfil colaborativo , pragmático e orientado a resultados.

title: Assistente Juridico Administrativo
description:
Estamos em busca de um Assistente Juridico Administrativo para fazer parte do time da Fevereiro & Cruz Marcas e Patentes, um escritório de 13 anos de idade na cidade de São Paulo e agora está iniciando a sua jornada na cidade de Campinas. Nosso maior propósito é gerar e agregar valor para as empresas através dos seus ativos marcas e patentes, com experiência de serviço, a fim de ficarmos marcados em suas memórias pela qualidade do nosso trabalho.

Principais responsabilidades da função:

• Abertura e cadastro de casos novos;

• Solicitação de cadastramento de clientes/documentos;

• Acompanhamento dos prazos administrativos;

• Gestão de ferramentas jurídicas;

• Preenchimento de formulários;

• Geração de guias e petições eletrônicas;

• Elaboração de peças administrativas e seu protocolamento;

• Análise de contratos;

• Apoio à elaboração de documentos legais. Auxilia na redação e organização de petições, contratos, relatórios, pareceres e outros documentos jurídicos.

• Realiza pesquisas em legislações, jurisprudências, doutrinas e outros documentos legais para fornecer informações atualizadas e embasar argumentos e defesas.

• Envio de e-mails periódicos;

• Elaboração de relatórios/pareceres para clientes;

• Atendimento a clientes.

Execução de outras atividades correlatas à função, que possam surgir no decorrer das operações, demonstrando flexibilidade e adaptabilidade para lidar com diversas demandas.


Requisitos:

• Bacharel em Direito ou cursando a partir do 4º semestre;

• Experiência com sistemas de gestão jurídica

• Capacidade de lidar com situações de estresse e pressão, especialmente ao lidar diretamente com os clientes.

• Demonstração de responsabilidade extrema no cumprimento das tarefas atribuídas.

• Proficiência excepcional na língua portuguesa, tanto na comunicação verbal quanto na escrita.

• Proatividade para antecipar necessidades e resolver problemas de forma eficiente.

• Habilidade organizacional para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e garantir a eficiência operacional.


Será considerado um diferencial ter experiência prévia no ramo da propriedade industrial.


Modelo de trabalho: presencial Disponibilidade de tempo: Horário: Segunda à sexta-feira, das 08:30h às 18:00h Contratação: CLT. Remuneração: R$2.500,00. Benefícios: Vale alimentação/refeição + vale transporte.

title: Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS) - HOME OFFICE
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS Automation and CA OPS/MVS) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) . The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.


You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
  • Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
  • Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.
  • JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language.
  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
  • Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
  • Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

description:
Sobre nós

title: Risk Control Specialist (Evening shift)
description:
About BingX

  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE


Responsibilities

  • Conduct user audits on the company's risk control platform
  • Monitor for and promptly respond to any abnormal transaction data, making judgments as necessary
  • Continually learn about the platform's rules and enhance personal and professional skills
  • Keep abreast of external competitors' changes in risk control rules and provide suggestions based on current regulations


Requirements

  • At least 1 year of working experience in risk control/transaction monitoring/customer support
  • Possess business sensitivity and awareness of risk
  • Strong psychological quality with effective communication and judgment skills
  • Strong logical thinking and data collection and analysis abilities
  • Strict adherence to professional ethics and information security and confidentiality in daily work
  • Work Schedule: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM (Brazil Time)


Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**To apply, kindly submit your resume in English. Please note that any other format will not be considered.**

Who we are:

Kajae is a premium staff augmentation company that connects top global talents to thriving US companies and clients offering fully remote opportunities. Our team hails from over 27 different countries, with the majority coming from the Philippines and Latin America. We pride ourselves on our tight-knit culture and strong bonds, despite working remotely across diverse timezones.



Job Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled and creative Graphic Designer with strong video editing capabilities and a solid, well-rounded portfolio. The ideal candidate has a keen eye for design, strong visual storytelling skills, and the ability to create engaging static and motion content that aligns with brand guidelines and marketing objectives. This role requires someone who can work independently, manage multiple creative projects, and deliver high-quality outputs consistently.


Key Responsibilities

  • Create visually compelling graphic designs for digital and marketing assets (social media, websites, ads, presentations, and branding materials)
  • Edit and produce high-quality videos for marketing, social media, and promotional use
  • Develop motion graphics, basic animations, and video transitions as needed
  • Ensure brand consistency across all visual and video assets
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and internal teams to translate concepts into creative outputs
  • Manage multiple design projects while meeting deadlines and quality standards
  • Review and refine designs and videos based on feedback and performance goals


Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Graphic Designer with a strong portfolio showcasing both design and video work
  • Solid video editing skills, including transitions, basic motion graphics, and storytelling
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro; After Effects is a plus)
  • Strong understanding of layout, typography, color theory, and visual hierarchy
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality
  • Ability to work independently in a remote or fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills and ability to incorporate feedback effectively
  • Experience creating content for social media, digital ads, or marketing campaigns
  • Knowledge of motion graphics or animation tools
  • Familiarity with brand guidelines and marketing performance metrics


Portfolio Requirement

  • A solid portfolio is required , showcasing graphic design work and video editing samples (including transitions and motion elements)



Benefits :

Competitive salary – paid in USD - Receive your compensation in US dollars, providing stability and global value for your hard work.

100% fully remote setup - Work from anywhere in the world—permanently. Enjoy the freedom and flexibility of a remote role while staying close to what matters most. No more commuting hassles, and more time for life’s important moments.

Healthy work-life balance - We prioritize your well-being. Through regular check-ins during your first few months, we offer ongoing support and career guidance. We also ensure you’re partnered with top-tier clients in a positive, healthy work environment.

Health insurance - Get covered starting your third month with us—your health and peace of mind matter.

Mental health support - Our in-house mental health professional is available to ensure you have access to the emotional and psychological support you need to thrive.

Referral bonuses - Know someone great? Refer them and earn up to USD 100 for every successful hire.

Fun virtual events - We host monthly virtual events filled with games, holiday celebrations, and exciting prizes. It’s a great way to connect and recharge as a team.

Kajae Spotlight bonus - Exceptional performance is recognized through our Kajae Spotlight program, where top performers earn cash rewards.

Kajae Tribe and rewards platform - Engage with the whole team through our internal social platform and earn coins for participating. Use them to bid in our lively auctions for prizes like AirPods, Apple Watches, Starbucks gift cards, shopping or experience vouchers, and more.

Continuing education opportunities - Access 100% free online courses through our university partners in the US. Earn academic credits that can go toward a Master’s or Graduate Degree—completely on us.

All-expense paid summits - Top performers and tenured team members may qualify to attend our exclusive annual summits. So far, we’ve held summits in Palawan, Bohol, and Boracay (Philippines), Cusco (Peru), and Punta Cana (Dominican Republic).

description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Desenvolvimento Salesforce Sênior


Requisitos:

Kotlin, com ênfase em Java Spring Boot, Python e AWS. Requisitos Técnicos: Kotlin (Habilidade Principal). Experiência com Kotlin para desenvolvimento backend. Conhecimento em frameworks como Ktor ou Spring Boot com Kotlin. Boas práticas de programação funcional e orientada a objetos em Kotlin. - Uso de coroutines para programação assíncrona. - Testes automatizados com JUnit, MockK ou Kotest. Java + Spring Boot. Experiência com Spring Boot e seus módulos (Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Cloud). - Uso de JPA/Hibernate para persistência de dados. - Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e GraphQL. - Testes com JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers. Python. Conhecimento básico ou intermediário para **scripts, automação e integração**. - Experiência com frameworks como **FastAPI ou Flask** é um diferencial. - Manipulação de dados com **Pandas e NumPy** (caso necessário). **AWS (Cloud)** - Experiência com **AWS Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, API Gateway e IAM**. - Infraestrutura como código (**Terraform, AWS CDK ou CloudFormation**). - Monitoramento e logging com **CloudWatch**. - Conhecimento em **ECS, EKS ou Kubernetes** é um diferencial. **Outros Conhecimentos Desejáveis** - Experiência com **CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD)**. - Banco de dados **SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB)**. - Mensageria com **Kafka ou RabbitMQ**. - Containers e Docker. - Arquitetura de microsserviços e eventos. Principais Responsabilidades do Desenvolvedor 1. Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento Backend Criar e manter microsserviços escaláveis usando Kotlin (Spring Boot). Projetar e desenvolver APIs REST e GraphQL. Implementar boas práticas de clean code, design patterns e SOLID. Gerenciar persistência de dados utilizando PostgreSQL, DynamoDB ou MongoDB. 2. Integração com AWS e Infraestrutura Desenvolver e otimizar soluções utilizando AWS Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, API Gateway e RDS. Criar pipelines de infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou AWS CDK). Implementar monitoramento e logging com AWS CloudWatch e Prometheus. 3. Processamento e Automação de Dados Construir pipelines de processamento de dados com Kafka ou AWS Kinesis. Criar automações e scripts auxiliares em Python para análise de dados, ETL ou machine learning. 4. Segurança e Performance Implementar OAuth2, JWT ou AWS Cognito para autenticação e autorização. Monitorar performance e escalabilidade, otimizando queries e serviços. 5. DevOps e CI/CD Automatizar deploys utilizando Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/Fargate ou EKS. Configurar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). 6. Colaboração e Melhoria Contínua Trabalhar em equipe, revisando códigos (Code Review) e propondo melhorias. Manter documentação técnica clara e atualizada. Participar de decisões arquiteturais e estratégias de evolução do sistema.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência com OmniStudio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;
  • Conhecimento em Business Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;
  • Experiência com Orchestration Management (OM), incluindo decomposição de pedidos e desenvolvimento de planos de orquestração para processos complexos e multi-step;
  • Conhecimento em Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) será considerado um diferencial, especialmente para gerenciar contratos ao longo de seu ciclo de vida, da criação à renovação e fechamento;

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

- Docker

- Azure

title: Data Architect with Snowflake, Python and Advance hands-on SQL
description:
Title: Data Architect with Snowflake, Python and Advance hands-on SQL

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract


Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind—making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15-30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.


Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants. We help brands discover what actually converts—should luxury skincare shoppers see lifestyle photos or close-up texture shots? Does a supplement brand's product page convert better with per-serving or per-bottle pricing? These decisions matter, and we make it simple to find the answers through visual editors, AI-powered recommendations, and expert guidance.


We're scaling rapidly with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores, from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of less than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners—handpicked by Shopify themselves and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.


What sets us apart isn't just our product—it's our world-class partnerships team (deeply embedded with the Shopify ecosystem and Shopify Platinum tech and agency partners) and our customer success organization that ensures brands actually get value from testing. We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem—not just a vendor.


As we accelerate growth, we're expanding our already-strong revenue organization. You'll have direct impact on our trajectory, real ownership over your book of business, and the chance to refine how we execute at scale.

We're a team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.


The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer at Shoplift, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the high-quality lead magnets, ad templates, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters—not through words, but through compelling visuals that show, don't tell.


This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert prospects into customers.


Here's what makes this role unique: We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously—our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, which is one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance here: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps this balance.


The creative challenge? We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world—the people running growth at brands like KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work when they see it because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by the idea of \"brand recognizes brand\" and want to create marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.


You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams to surface the stories and data that make our marketing materials resonate.



What You'll Do

Marketing Creative & Campaign Assets

  • Design static ad templates for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets (ebooks, guides, one-pagers) that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before/after, without Shoplift vs. with Shoplift) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Create templated creative systems that can be adapted for different campaigns while maintaining brand consistency


Brand & Sales Materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow \"show-don't-tell\" philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and other recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale


Product Marketing Visualization

  • Design product marketing materials that highlight the excellence of the app
  • Create motion graphics and other dynamic visuals for various web mediums
  • Build a library of reusable marketing assets that maintain visual consistency


You'll contribute immediately—creating assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.



You're a Great Fit If...

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency—you build organized, scalable systems
  • You understand brand nuance—the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking—you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with US-based team
  • Portfolio demonstrating marketing design work that shows personality and sophistication (applications without portfolio won't be considered)


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Motion design or animation skills
  • Performance marketing background (you understand what makes ads convert)
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention


You'll thrive if you:

  • Get excited by the challenge of marketing to marketers—people who recognize great work
  • Can take a brief and run with it without extensive art direction
  • Work well asynchronously across time zones
  • Move fast, iterate based on feedback, and don't take revisions personally
  • Care about business outcomes, not just beautiful design
  • Appreciate brand personality and aren't afraid to push creative boundaries (within reason)



What We Offer

Salary: $45,000 - $55,000 USD annually

Benefits:

  • Flexible remote work
  • Generous time off policy
  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
  • Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out
  • Collaborate with our product designer (also Brazil-based) on maintaining design consistency



How to Apply

Applications without a portfolio submitted through this link won't be considered:


When submitting you'll be asked to include:

  • Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2B SaaS marketing work)
  • A short note and example marketing asset (3-4 sentences): Show us one marketing asset you're proud of and tell us why it worked.


We're excited to meet you!

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind—making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15-30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.


Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants. We help brands discover what actually converts—should luxury skincare shoppers see lifestyle photos or close-up texture shots? Does a supplement brand's product page convert better with per-serving or per-bottle pricing? These decisions matter, and we make it simple to find the answers through visual editors, AI-powered recommendations, and expert guidance.


We're scaling rapidly with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores, from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of less than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners—handpicked by Shopify themselves and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.


What sets us apart isn't just our product—it's our world-class partnerships team (deeply embedded with the Shopify ecosystem and Shopify Platinum tech and agency partners) and our customer success organization that ensures brands actually get value from testing. We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem—not just a vendor.


As we accelerate growth, we're expanding our already-strong revenue organization. You'll have direct impact on our trajectory, real ownership over your book of business, and the chance to refine how we execute at scale.

We're a team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.


The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer at Shoplift, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the high-quality lead magnets, ad templates, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters—not through words, but through compelling visuals that show, don't tell.


This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert prospects into customers.


Here's what makes this role unique: We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously—our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, which is one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance here: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps this balance.


The creative challenge? We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world—the people running growth at brands like KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work when they see it because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by the idea of \"brand recognizes brand\" and want to create marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.


You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams to surface the stories and data that make our marketing materials resonate.



What You'll Do

Marketing Creative & Campaign Assets

  • Design static ad templates for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets (ebooks, guides, one-pagers) that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before/after, without Shoplift vs. with Shoplift) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Create templated creative systems that can be adapted for different campaigns while maintaining brand consistency


Brand & Sales Materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow \"show-don't-tell\" philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and other recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale


Product Marketing Visualization

  • Design product marketing materials that highlight the excellence of the app
  • Create motion graphics and other dynamic visuals for various web mediums
  • Build a library of reusable marketing assets that maintain visual consistency


You'll contribute immediately—creating assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.



You're a Great Fit If...

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency—you build organized, scalable systems
  • You understand brand nuance—the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking—you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with US-based team
  • Portfolio demonstrating marketing design work that shows personality and sophistication (applications without portfolio won't be considered)


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Motion design or animation skills
  • Performance marketing background (you understand what makes ads convert)
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention


You'll thrive if you:

  • Get excited by the challenge of marketing to marketers—people who recognize great work
  • Can take a brief and run with it without extensive art direction
  • Work well asynchronously across time zones
  • Move fast, iterate based on feedback, and don't take revisions personally
  • Care about business outcomes, not just beautiful design
  • Appreciate brand personality and aren't afraid to push creative boundaries (within reason)



What We Offer

Salary: $45,000 - $55,000 USD annually

Benefits:

  • Flexible remote work
  • Generous time off policy
  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
  • Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out
  • Collaborate with our product designer (also Brazil-based) on maintaining design consistency



How to Apply

Applications without a portfolio submitted through this link won't be considered:


When submitting you'll be asked to include:

  • Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2B SaaS marketing work)
  • A short note and example marketing asset (3-4 sentences): Show us one marketing asset you're proud of and tell us why it worked.


We're excited to meet you!

title: Desenvolvedor Java Back-end
description:
Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Back-end Java para atuar em um ambiente de alta criticidade , com foco em integrações, mensageria e microsserviços , participando ativamente do desenvolvimento de soluções robustas e escaláveis.


Stack Tecnológico

Obrigatório:

  • Java 11+;
  • Spring Boot;
  • APIs REST;
  • RabbitMQ;
  • MongoDB;
  • Oracle.

Desejável:

  • Kafka;
  • Redis;
  • Docker;
  • Kubernetes / OpenShift;
  • Observabilidade (Datadog, AppDynamics, ELK).

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Criar e consumir filas RabbitMQ (listeners para eventos de renovação e cancelamento).
  • Implementar integrações REST com sistemas como BCP, Bureau, Dossiê, Sinistro e Vistoria Prévia.
  • Desenvolver endpoints para geração de ofertas APA / AFI.
  • Realizar manutenção e ajustes em tabelas Oracle.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de Clean Code, SOLID e Design Patterns.
  • Participar de code reviews e pair programming.
  • Garantir cobertura de testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito).

Requisitos Técnicos

Obrigatórios:

  • 3+ anos de experiência com Java e Spring Boot em produção.
  • Experiência sólida com microsserviços e APIs REST.
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (RabbitMQ ou Kafka).
  • Domínio de bancos relacionais (Oracle/PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB).
  • Versionamento de código com Git / GitLab.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Kubernetes / OpenShift.
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade e monitoramento.
  • Certificação Oracle Certified Professional.

title: Senior Applied Scientist
description:
Senior Applied Scientist (Remote – Brazil)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Location: Remote (Brazil) – São Paulo

Duration: Open-Ended


We are seeking a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy machine learning, causal, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making. This role focuses on transforming complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in machine learning, optimization, forecasting, and causal inference, particularly within Marketing or closely related domains. You will own the full ML lifecycle — from data acquisition and experimentation to deployment and monitoring — while working closely with cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

You will operate at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy, building systems that deliver measurable impact in areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems


Key Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases, including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into well-defined objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Engineer feature representations that capture customer behavior, engagement, value, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments such as A/B tests, incrementality tests, geo experiments, and causal impact analyses
  • Build and maintain robust offline and online evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, GMV/LTV)
  • Partner with Marketing and Sales teams to define success metrics, guardrails, and decision thresholds
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle, including data ingestion, feature engineering, training pipelines, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services and systems that integrate into business workflows and platforms
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering and Platform teams to productionize models and experimentation frameworks
  • Communicate insights, model performance, limitations, and business implications to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Influence roadmap prioritization by linking ML initiatives to revenue and growth impact
  • Provide technical leadership on modeling approaches, system design, and evaluation standards
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and contribute to building Customer Science best practices and reusable ML platforms

title: LLM - Business Analyst
description:
Short Term Contract (2 months)


Responsibilities

- Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.

- Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.

- Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.

- Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.

- Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.

- Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.

- Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements

- Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.

- Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.

- Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).

- Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.

- High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.

- Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.

- Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have

- Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.

- Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.

- Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.

title: TIBCO EBX Developer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Java development, ideally applied within TIBCO EBX extensions or customizations;
  • Hands‑on experience developing on TIBCO EBX (data modeling, workflows, services, UI configuration, data quality rules);
  • Understanding of Master Data Management (MDM) processes and governance, especially in EBX contexts;
  • Strong understanding of Java design patterns, MVC, and Java data structures, supporting EBX development best practices;
  • English B2 and Portuguese native;
  • Must relocate to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: relocation to Portugal and in here will be 2x on-site.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send apply!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: IT Project & Implementation Specialist
description:
✨ Seu talento impulsiona o nosso futuro


Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar como especialista em Serviços Profissionais na Lynx Financial Crime Tech, com uma posição baseada no Brasil, em modelo remoto, em colaboração com o time global de Serviços Profissionais em Madrid (Espanha) e com foco em clientes no Brasil e em outros países da América Latina.


A Lynx Financial Crime Tech S.A, é uma empresa de software baseado em IA, especializada em detectar e prever padrões de comportamento. Liderados por uma equipe experiente do setor financeiro e acadêmico, desenvolvemos e implementamos tecnologias de IA de ponta e autoaprendizado. Nossa plataforma se destaca em tecnologias de processamento de transações de baixa latência e está disponível tanto on-premise quanto em nuvem.

Priorizamos VISÃO, AGILIDADE e VELOCIDADE para oferecer experiências excepcionais aos clientes e construímos relacionamentos duradouros e de confiança com algumas das principais instituições financeiras, fintechs e empresas comerciais em todo o mundo.

Adotamos uma forte cultura de risco e esperamos que toda a nossa equipe, independentemente do cargo que ocupem, tenha uma atitude proativa e responsável em relação à gestão de riscos. A Lynx se orgulha de ser uma organização com igualdade de oportunidades, independentemente de identidade de gênero, cultura ou deficiência. Nossa missão é contribuir para que mais pessoas e empresas prosperem.


O que você vai fazer

Como IT Project & Implementation Specialist, seu objetivo será garantir um serviço excelente para nossos clientes sediados no Brasil (e em outras regiões da América Latina), participando ativamente das diferentes etapas do ciclo de vida: onboarding, implantação, acompanhamento e novas necessidades.

Precisamos de alguém como você para nos ajudar em diferentes frentes:

· Liderar e gerir projetos de implementação das nossas soluções.

· Gerenciar o relacionamento com os clientes: identificar novas necessidades, resolver dúvidas e oferecer orientação sobre o uso correto das nossas soluções.

· Fornecer consultoria especializada e executar os serviços profissionais das nossas soluções de Detecção e Prevenção de Crime Financeiro e Lavagem de Dinheiro.

· Dar suporte técnico aos nossos times internos de Vendas nas fases iniciais de contato com clientes: demos, reuniões técnicas etc.

· Atuar como elo entre nossos clientes e as equipes de Desenvolvimento e Suporte.


✅ O que buscamos em você

Experiência em gestão de projetos de tecnologia;

Ensino superior completo;

Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras ou empresas relacionadas ao setor;

Experiência em departamentos de Serviços Profissionais em outras empresas do setor;

Idiomas: domínio avançado de inglês (mandatório).


✅ O que pode contar pontos a mais

Conhecimentos de Linux – nível usuário.

Espanhol avançado;

Conhecimento em Fraude e/ou Lavagem de Dinheiro;

Capacidade para trabalhar em equipe;

Boas habilidades de comunicação;

Capacidade de se adaptar a ambientes em constante mudança.


Seguinte passo

Candidate-se e se você conhece alguém que possa estar procurando por essa oportunidade, compartilhe.

title: IT Project & Implementation Specialist
description:
✨ Seu talento impulsiona o nosso futuro


Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar como especialista em Serviços Profissionais na Lynx Financial Crime Tech, com uma posição baseada no Brasil, em modelo remoto, em colaboração com o time global de Serviços Profissionais em Madrid (Espanha) e com foco em clientes no Brasil e em outros países da América Latina.


A Lynx Financial Crime Tech S.A, é uma empresa de software baseado em IA, especializada em detectar e prever padrões de comportamento. Liderados por uma equipe experiente do setor financeiro e acadêmico, desenvolvemos e implementamos tecnologias de IA de ponta e autoaprendizado. Nossa plataforma se destaca em tecnologias de processamento de transações de baixa latência e está disponível tanto on-premise quanto em nuvem.

Priorizamos VISÃO, AGILIDADE e VELOCIDADE para oferecer experiências excepcionais aos clientes e construímos relacionamentos duradouros e de confiança com algumas das principais instituições financeiras, fintechs e empresas comerciais em todo o mundo.

Adotamos uma forte cultura de risco e esperamos que toda a nossa equipe, independentemente do cargo que ocupem, tenha uma atitude proativa e responsável em relação à gestão de riscos. A Lynx se orgulha de ser uma organização com igualdade de oportunidades, independentemente de identidade de gênero, cultura ou deficiência. Nossa missão é contribuir para que mais pessoas e empresas prosperem.


O que você vai fazer

Como IT Project & Implementation Specialist, seu objetivo será garantir um serviço excelente para nossos clientes sediados no Brasil (e em outras regiões da América Latina), participando ativamente das diferentes etapas do ciclo de vida: onboarding, implantação, acompanhamento e novas necessidades.

Precisamos de alguém como você para nos ajudar em diferentes frentes:

· Liderar e gerir projetos de implementação das nossas soluções.

· Gerenciar o relacionamento com os clientes: identificar novas necessidades, resolver dúvidas e oferecer orientação sobre o uso correto das nossas soluções.

· Fornecer consultoria especializada e executar os serviços profissionais das nossas soluções de Detecção e Prevenção de Crime Financeiro e Lavagem de Dinheiro.

· Dar suporte técnico aos nossos times internos de Vendas nas fases iniciais de contato com clientes: demos, reuniões técnicas etc.

· Atuar como elo entre nossos clientes e as equipes de Desenvolvimento e Suporte.

Experiência em gestão de projetos de tecnologia;

Ensino superior completo;

Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras ou empresas relacionadas ao setor;

Experiência em departamentos de Serviços Profissionais em outras empresas do setor;

Idiomas: domínio avançado de inglês (mandatório).

Conhecimentos de Linux – nível usuário.

Capacidade para trabalhar em equipe;

title: Lead Data Architect – Azure Databricks & Advanced
description:
Lead Data Architect – Azure Databricks & Advanced Analytics


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Lead Data Architect with deep expertise in Azure Databricks and advanced analytics to design and deliver scalable, cloud-native data solutions. This role requires strong hands-on technical skills combined with architectural leadership to drive end-to-end analytics platforms aligned with business objectives.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in big data technologies, data engineering, and Azure cloud services, with a strong focus on Databricks, SQL, and modern data lakehouse architectures.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks and Microsoft Fabric
  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional IT teams to gather requirements and translate them into effective data solutions
  • Own end-to-end delivery of data platforms, ensuring alignment with business needs, architectural standards, and best practices
  • Design and develop scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes using Azure Databricks, PySpark, and related tools
  • Integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services, including Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory , and on-premise systems
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to data engineering teams, fostering continuous learning and innovation
  • Ensure comprehensive documentation of data architectures, pipelines, and data flows
  • Enforce best practices for code quality, data security, governance, and scalability
  • Stay current with evolving Databricks and Azure technologies to drive continuous improvement and innovation


Essential Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake
  • Proficiency in big data technologies such as Spark, Hadoop , and data processing frameworks like PySpark
  • Deep understanding of Azure services including Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2), Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory
  • Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines, data lakes, and data warehouses
  • Advanced SQL skills and familiarity with NoSQL databases
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems such as Git
  • Strong knowledge of cloud security and governance best practices


Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues
  • Proven leadership and mentoring skills, with experience leading and guiding data engineering teams


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Power BI for dashboarding and reporting
  • Exposure to Microsoft Fabric for analytics and integration workloads
  • Knowledge of Spark Streaming for real-time data processing
  • Familiarity with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices


Experience Requirements

  • 12+ years of demonstrated experience in developing data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Databricks, Azure Synapse notebooks, and Azure Data Factory
  • Strong hands-on experience with Delta Tables, Delta Lake, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2
  • Proven expertise using Auto Loader and Delta Live Tables for efficient data ingestion and transformation
  • Experience building and optimizing query layers using Databricks SQL
  • Demonstrated experience integrating Databricks with Azure Synapse, ADLS Gen2, and Power BI for end-to-end analytics solutions
  • Prior experience developing, optimizing, and deploying Power BI reports
  • Solid understanding of modern CI/CD practices , particularly for Databricks and cloud-native architectures

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.


Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.
  • A team of about 10 people consisting of a team lead, a sw architect, a few senior developers. After your SW design is approved you are responsible for implementing the design in Python & C for new modules.
  • During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.
  • The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • We are looking for colleagues with at least 5 years of development experience.
  • Python: application coding
  • Linux (one of more of the following): familiar with command line tools, makefile, git, shell and python scripting
  • Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.
  • Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced
