title: Desenvolvedor de Firmware Sr
description:
Desenvolvedor de Firmware Sr - Foco em Microcontroladores | 100% Remota | CLT


Sobre nós e Resumo da posição

A Control iD é uma indústria brasileira, especializada no desenvolvimento de relógio de ponto, controle de acesso e equipamentos para automação comercial. Aqui você terá a chance de criar soluções que conectam +300 mil dispositivos IoT e impactam +1 milhão de usuários ativos, em um ambiente que valoriza inovação e liberdade tecnológica.


Buscamos um Desenvolvedor de Firmware Sr para fazer parte da nossa equipe de Engenharia (focado em microcontroladores). Nossa empresa passa por um momento de crescimento e temos a missão de desenvolver novos talentos em nossa equipe. O cargo pretende desenvolver nossos produtos.


O que buscamos (obrigatórios):

  • Senioridade comprovada em embarcados
  • Experiência com ESP32 + ESP-IDF em produção
  • Domínio de C/C++
  • Experiência com RTOS, com destaque para FreeRTOS
  • Git no dia a dia (fluxo de branches, PR, code review)


Habilidades desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em Nordic (nRF) e/ou STM32
  • Conhecimento em BLE/Wi-Fi, OTA, segurança, consumo de energia, pipelines de build/test



Seu papel será:

  • Arquitetura e desenvolvimento de firmware em C/C++
  • Design e implementação com FreeRTOS (concorrência, sincronização, temporização, prioridades, watchdog, heap/stack tuning)
  • Integração de periféricos e drivers (I2C/SPI/UART/PWM/ADC, etc.)
  • Power management e baixo consumo: estratégias de sleep/deep sleep, definição de wake-up sources, janelas de atividade (acorda/dorme) e gerenciamento do rádio (Wi-Fi/BLE), com medições de consumo, identificação de hotspots e melhorias de autonomia
  • Troubleshooting avançado: investigação de falhas intermitentes, análise de logs e core dumps, diagnóstico de resets/crashes e depuração de concorrência (deadlocks/races), com otimização de heap/stack e performance
  • Processo de engenharia: Git, PRs, revisão de código, padrões e documentação


Diferenciais da vaga:

  • 100% remoto;
  • Participação ativa nos produtos desenvolvidos da área;


Benefícios

  • VR/VA sem desconto em folha;
  • Convênio médico com coparticipação apenas quando usar;
  • PLR;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Totalpass.

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Sênior (.NET / C#)
description:
Desenvolvedor Backend Sênior (.NET / C#)

Modelo: Remoto

Sobre o desafio Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior para atuar em uma squad estratégica responsável por sistemas críticos de pricing, políticas comerciais, descontos escalonados, contas correntes financeiras, conciliações e integrações corporativas. Você irá trabalhar em um ambiente de alta complexidade, alto volume transacional, forte governança, requisitos de auditoria e integrações distribuídas, suportando múltiplos canais digitais B2B (e-commerce, chatbot, APIs, EDI) e sistemas corporativos como SAP, ServiceNow, motores externos de cálculo e plataformas de dados. O papel exige forte capacidade de engenharia, visão sistêmica, responsabilidade técnica e maturidade para operar em ambiente regulado, com foco em performance, resiliência, observabilidade e escalabilidade. Responsabilidades

Desenvolver e evoluir APIs e serviços backend em C# (.NET) para sistemas de pricing, regras comerciais, incentivos, contas correntes e conciliações financeiras.

Atuar no desenho de arquiteturas cloud-native, orientadas a eventos e microsserviços, garantindo escalabilidade, disponibilidade e tolerância a falhas.

Implementar soluções com foco em: o Alta performance e baixa latência o Idempotência, versionamento, snapshots e rastreabilidade o Consistência de dados e integridade transacional o Observabilidade (logs, métricas, tracing distribuído)

Integrar sistemas internos e externos (ex: SAP, plataformas de parceiros, motores de cálculo, mensageria, APIs públicas e privadas).

Trabalhar com bancos relacionais e modelagem de dados complexa (PostgreSQL / SQL Server), incluindo otimização de queries e estratégia de índices.

Garantir padrões de qualidade: o Testes automatizados o Code review o Clean Architecture / SOLID o Segurança e compliance

Atuar em conjunto com Produto, Arquitetura, QA, DevOps e áreas de negócio, participando ativamente de refinamentos técnicos e tomada de decisão.

Apoiar tecnicamente desenvolvedores mais juniores, elevando o nível do time (mentoria técnica).


Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios

Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor Backend Sênior com C# e .NET (.NET Core / .NET 8 e 10) Domínio de: o APIs REST o Microsserviços o Arquitetura em camadas / Clean Architecture o Design Patterns

Experiência comprovada com: o Sistemas de alta performance e alto volume o Processamento assíncrono o Mensageria (SQS e SNS) o Controle de concorrência

Experiência com bancos relacionais: o PostgreSQL e SQL Server o Modelagem relacional complexa o Otimização de queries e performance

Experiência em ambientes cloud AWS o Containers o Observabilidade o Monitoramento o Escalabilidade

Práticas de engenharia: o Testes automatizados o Versionamento (Git) o Code review Diferenciais (Nice to Have)

Experiência com: o Sistemas financeiros, pricing, billing, conciliação, ledger, marketplaces ou e-commerce B2B. o Arquitetura orientada a eventos. o Processamento batch e streaming. o Feature toggles, blue-green deploy, canary release.

Conhecimento em: o Domain-Driven Design (DDD) o Event Sourcing / CQRS o Observabilidade avançada (Datadog, OpenTelemetry).

Vivência em ambientes regulados, auditáveis ou com forte governança. Experiência integrando com ERPs (SAP ou similares).

title: US Immigration Paralegal (Employment Based Petitions)
description:
Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Type: Full-Time


Company Description

Beyond Border is a modern immigration platform founded by immigrants, for immigrants, dedicated to supporting U.S. mobility needs for technologists, artists, and skilled professionals. The company's mission is to simplify the immigration process, making it accessible and efficient for individuals and businesses alike. With innovative solutions and expertise, Beyond Border provides comprehensive support throughout the immigration journey to help clients achieve their goals. Learn more about their services at Beyond Border Global.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote position for a Immigration Paralegal specializing in U.S. Employment-Based Petitions. The responsibilities include assisting with the preparation and submission of employment-based visa petitions and other immigration filings, conducting research on immigration law and policies, reviewing and organizing legal documents, and collaborating with attorneys and clients to ensure compliance. The candidate will also provide ongoing support to clients, maintain case management systems, and monitor deadlines and case progress.


Qualifications

  • 2+ years of US O1,EB1,EB2 petition experience with a successful track record of approvals is a must.
  • Strong knowledge of Law, Immigration Law, and Immigration Issues
  • Experience with Visas and Employment-Based Immigration Processes
  • Proficiency in Legal Document Preparation and detail-oriented case management
  • Exceptional organizational, time-management, and written communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines in a remote environment
  • Bachelor’s degree or paralegal certification; prior experience in immigration law is highly preferred

title: Especialista em Integração / Líder Técnico de Integração
description:
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de Especialistas em Integração / Líderes Técnicos de Integração para atuar no desenho, implementação e liderança técnica de soluções de integração robustas, escaláveis e de alta performance. O profissional será referência técnica para o time, apoiando decisões arquiteturais e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Atuação para cliente sediado em Portugal


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar tecnicamente iniciativas de integração entre sistemas e plataformas.
  • Desenhar e implementar arquiteturas baseadas em eventos, mensageria e APIs.
  • Definir padrões, boas práticas e guidelines de integração.
  • Atuar junto às equipes de desenvolvimento para garantir qualidade, performance e escalabilidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos pipelines de CI/CD e processos de entrega.


Requisitos

  • Graduação ou Mestrado em Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Solida de experiência com integrações de sistemas ( Nivel Sr/ especialista +) .
  • Experiência sólida com soluções de streaming e mensageria , como:
  • Kafka, Solace, Pulsar, RabbitMQ ou similares.
  • Experiência com API Gateway e API Management , como:
  • Apigee, Kong, Gravitee ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de integração , tais como:
  • MuleSoft, Oracle SOA, Apache NiFi, Boomi, Apache Camel, entre outras.
  • Domínio de Git e pipelines de CI/CD , com forte conhecimento em práticas de integração e entrega contínua, visando otimizar processos de desenvolvimento e garantir entregas rápidas e com qualidade.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação remota no fuso horario de Portugal


Diferenciais

  • Atuação prévia como Tech Lead ou Arquiteto de Integração.
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de grande escala.
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (EDA) e microsserviços.

title: Senior Splunk Engineer
description:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Splunk Engineer to take over and operate the on-premise Splunk SIEM platform. As part of the transition from Infosys, you will be responsible for stabilizing and continuously improving an existing enterprise-scale SIEM environment.


You will own all Splunk operations across Plan & Build, 24/7 Operations, Release & Patch Management, CIM-based Log Onboarding, Parser development, Hardening, Configuration Management, and Incident/Problem/Change processes.


Responsibilities

1. Plan & Build

  • Perform CIM-compliant log onboarding, parser creation, documentation.
  • Conduct onboarding due diligence and demand analysis.
  • Create Firewall/VPN/Routing change requests and validate changes.
  • Manage ingestion pipelines via Cribl, Syslog-ng (TLS), Splunk UF/HF, SCP.
  • Deploy and scale Splunk components using Terraform and Ansible.
  • Build trend and capacity analyses.


2. Operations (24/7 enterprise-grade operations)

  • Ensure full Splunk platform operation, monitoring, performance, EPS/log flow.
  • Handle Incidents, Service Requests, Changes, and Problems under MBG ITSM.
  • Lead Major Incident Management (P1/P2) with 24/7 on-call rotation.
  • Build and operate Health Check dashboards and QA reports.


3. Configuration & Release Management

  • Implement approved changes across Splunk components.
  • Perform daily configuration backups (KV stores, Apps, Configs).
  • Maintain automation libraries (Terraform, Ansible, scripts).
  • Manage Splunk patching and releases (maintain N-1 level).
  • Support up to 12 minor + 1 major release per year.


4. Security, Hardening & Compliance

  • System hardening and vulnerability remediation.
  • Operate via secure access methods (Jump hosts, SuSSHi, 2FA).
  • Conduct vulnerability scans and support SOC threat analysis.
  • Automate SOP-based operational workflows.


5. Transition

  • Take over existing MBG Splunk operations.
  • Validate and enhance current configurations, parsers, and deployments.
  • Ensure stability during transition and hypercare.


Requirements

Technical Skills

  • 5–10 years Splunk/SIEM experience in large enterprises.
  • Expertise in Splunk Architecture, CIM onboarding, parser development, Syslog-ng, certificates.
  • Strong scripting: Terraform, Ansible, Bash/Python.
  • Experience stabilizing existing SIEM environments.



Certifications (required)

Minimum two of:

  • Splunk Core Certified User
  • Splunk Core Certified Power User
  • Splunk Enterprise Admin
  • Splunk Enterprise Architect
  • Optional: Splunk ES


Soft Skills

  • Strong communication in enterprise environments.
  • Clear documentation skills.
  • Proactive, quality-driven work style.
  • Fluent English (German beneficial).

title: Nokia MPLS Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career! Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, thats why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


Key Responsibilities

· Design and implement MPLS networks using Nokia 7750 SR and 7705 SAR platforms.

· Configure and maintain DWDM/OTN systems using Nokia 1830 PSS.

· Perform network provisioning, testing, and troubleshooting across IP and optical layers.

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support network migrations from legacy SONET/TDM to MPLS/DWDM.

· Monitor network performance and optimize routing and wavelength assignments.

· Maintain and update network documentation and configuration standards.

· Interface with Nokia support and vendors for escalations and firmware upgrades.


Required Skills & Qualifications

· Strong hands-on experience with Nokia IP/MPLS platforms (7750 SR, 7705 SAR).

· Deep understanding of DWDM, OTN, and optical transport technologies.

· Familiarity with routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, IS-IS, RSVP-TE, Segment Routing).

· Experience with network management tools like Nokia NSP (Network Services Platform).

· Proficiency in troubleshooting tools (OTDR, spectrum analyzers, Wireshark).

· Certifications such as NRS I/II (Nokia Network Routing Specialist) are a plus.

· Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

title: PE Deal Origination Associate
description:
Caprae Capital Partners


Caprae Capital Partners is a next-generation private equity and venture platform built by operators, not career financiers. Led by founder Kevin Hong , a serial tech entrepreneur who has scaled companies to $31M ARR and $7M in revenue , Caprae was formed alongside fellow entrepreneurs who have achieved eight-figure and nine-figure exits (including acquisitions by Twitter and Square ). The broader partner network includes a former NASA software engineer and a former Chief of Staff at Google, a team engineered for innovation and disruption.


Since launching in 2025, Caprae has already closed over $50M in transaction value , with $80M+ across its ecosystem , and an additional $60M scheduled to close by Q1 2026 . The company has been growing 20%+ MoM for 12 months, and this trend is expected to continue for the next several months.


Caprae is rethinking how entrepreneurship, capital, and talent connect. We operate at the intersection of private equity, venture operations, and founder enablement, and we move aggressively. This is not a traditional finance firm.


Caprae is redefining how entrepreneurship and capital connect. We operate at the intersection of private equity, venture operations, and founder enablement, and we move fast.


Role Description


We’re looking for a PE Deal Origination Associate with a sharp mind, strong communication skills, and the drive to turn conversations into real deals.


This is a full-time, front-line role for someone exceptional at cold outreach, confident presenting to executives, and energized by building pipeline from scratch. You’ll be on the front lines of growth—initiating conversations, building relationships with business owners, and helping convert opportunities into closed transactions across Caprae’s platform and portfolio.

This is not a passive sales or research role. You’ll learn how private equity actually works by doing it.

Responsibilites

  • Conduct high-volume, high-quality cold outreach (up to ~20 hours per week)
  • Book meetings with founders, CEOs, and business owners across industries
  • Support and, over time, lead sales and deal conversations
  • Help craft and deliver compelling narratives around Caprae’s offerings
  • Work closely with senior leadership to prioritize and pursue high-value opportunities
  • Track, manage, and report on outreach pipeline, meetings, and conversion metrics
  • Assist in select account management and client success conversations post-close
  • Contribute to brand positioning, investor relations, and PR initiatives as needed


What we look for

  • Strong cold-calling and outbound communication skills—clear, confident, and concise
  • Comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders and building rapport quickly
  • Highly motivated, autonomous, and performance-driven
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments
  • Strong interest in entrepreneurship, private equity, or finance
  • Finance education strongly preferred
  • Must be strong with numbers —this is not a fluff role


Culture Fit

We strongly prefer recent graduates or early-career candidates .

This role is ideal for smart, hungry, coachable people who want to learn private equity from the ground up . Traditional finance experience is not required - and in some cases, too much institutional experience (investment banking, rigid PE or sales orgs) can be a downside due to baked-in habits.

We care more about judgment, work ethic, and output than pedigree.


Career Growth

This role is built for rapid advancement . High performers can be promoted to Manager-level responsibility in months, not years , with ownership over pipeline, junior teammates, and meaningful deal flow. Compensation scales aggressively with performance. In addition to a competitive base salary, top performers earn absurd bonuses tied directly to deal closes and conversion , not tenure or politics. If you consistently originate high-quality opportunities and help close transactions, your total compensation can quickly outpace traditional entry-level finance and consulting roles .

This is a meritocratic environment: output → trust → responsibility → compensation .


Compensation

  • Competitive base salary
  • Generous commissions for each qualified meeting and deal closed
  • Absurd upside on deal closes for top performers
  • Performance bonuses tied directly to output and conversion
  • Fast-track growth into Manager, leadership, or platform roles within Caprae


Caprae Capital Info

title: Analista de negócios sênior
description:
Estamos procurando um profissional com capacidade de realizar a análise de negócios, na área de Recursos Nauturais, orientando a equipe no desenvolvimento e/ou manutenção de soluções de GIS/TI nas fases de Design, Construção, Tecnologia, Requisitos, Teste, Infraestrutura, Configuração e Qualidade.


Formação:

  • Superior completo em Ciências Exatas, da Terra e afins.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento do sistema ArcGIS;
  • Conhecimento de SIG;
  • Conhecimento em TI/infraestrutura;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios;
  • Capacidade de aferir a qualidade da entrega através de testes.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Conceito de Sensoriamento Remoto
  • Conhecimento na área de Recursos Naturais (preferencialmente mineração e/ou meio ambiente);
  • Capacidade de elaborar Plano de Teste e Caderno/Procedimento de Testes;
  • Conhecimento de DevOps;
  • Certificações;
  • Especializações/Mestrado;
  • Inglês Avançado.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Interpretar documentação e informações de negócio compreendendo processos de negócio mapeados e contribuindo para a definição da arquitetura e implementação da solução e ao atendimento das necessidades de negócio existentes.
  • Criar documentação de usuário e administração de sistemas desenvolvidos garantindo o registro do processo e práticas utilizadas.
  • Conduzir processos de Discovery
  • Realizar o levantamento dos requisitos da aplicação
  • Orientar a análise, modelagem e documentação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais.
  • Disseminar o entendimento sobre os processos de negócio necessários à implementação da solução, assimilando e orientando o uso de conceitos e vocabulário próprio das áreas de negócio envolvidas no projeto.
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios.
  • Capacidade de aferir a qualidade da entrega através de testes.
  • Capacidade de elaborar Plano de Teste e Caderno/Procedimento de Testes de alta complexidade.
  • Avaliar e selecionar as opções da plataforma ESRI que melhor atendam uma respectiva solução.

title: Design Executive
description:
Vantage is a global, multi-asset broker based in Sydney, offering clients access to trading CFDs on Forex, Commodities, Indices, Shares, and Cryptocurrencies. With over 10 years of market experience, Vantage has a strong presence with more than 1,000 employees across 30 global offices. Vantage provides a trusted trading ecosystem and a user-friendly platform for clients to capitalize on trading opportunities.


Client Relationship Growth Design Executive


Key responsibilities:


  • Assist in the creation and execution of visual assets for digital and print platforms, including websites, social media, emails, and promotional materials.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, product, and sales) to produce design solutions that align with brand guidelines and business objectives.
  • Manage multiple design projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to project specifications.
  • Maintain and organise design files, ensuring easy access and consistency across projects.
  • Adapt and optimise designs based on feedback from stakeholders, ensuring alignment with brand voice and vision.
  • Stay updated on design trends, tools, and techniques to contribute fresh ideas and innovative solutions to the team.
  • Assist with photo editing, typography, and layout adjustments as needed.
  • Create and edit video content and GIFs for social media, marketing campaigns, and web use.


Qualifications


To be successful in this role, you’ll have:


  • Qualification in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Strong understanding of design principles, typography, colour theory, and layout composition.
  • Experience in creating and editing video content and GIFs using video editing tools.
  • Experience with 3D design and modelling software.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to present ideas clearly.
  • Strong organisational skills, ability to manage time effectively, and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and respond well to constructive feedback.
  • A portfolio showcasing a range of design work across different mediums (please include with your application).
  • Great interest in the finance and trading industry.
  • Additional digital marketing skills are advantageous.



Perks

  • Young and talented team, and you will get full support from everyone.
  • We do great work, and you will be a part of the amazing journey.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pl/Sr
description:
Somos a maior multinacional brasileira e estamos entre as 100 maiores empresas de TI do mundo.

Estamos presentes em 41 países com +30k colaboradores. A Stefanini tem como principal objetivo auxiliar os clientes a encontrar, por meio de soluções personalizadas, a maneira ideal para alcançar seus desafios, impulsionando a inovação digital.

E queremos mais!


Sua missão será atuar no time de Desenvolvedores Stefanini atendendo um dos principais Bancos do Brasil.


Compor o time de desenvolvimento, assumindo itens de trabalho para desenvolvimento a cada Sprint. Realizar as atividades inerentes ao desenvolvimento tais como análise e design, testes e com ênfase em programação. Gerir seu próprio trabalho sinalizando prontamente para a equipe sobre eventuais atrasos.


Responsabilidades e Habilidades:


Compor o time de desenvolvimento, assumindo itens de trabalho para desenvolvimento a cada Sprint. Realizar as atividades inerentes ao desenvolvimento – ênfase em programação - tais como análise e design, testes e programação. Gerir seu próprio trabalho sinalizando prontamente para a equipe sobre eventuais atrasos ou outros impedimentos.


HABILIDADES

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Desenvolvimento Salesforce Sênior


Requisitos:

  • Desenvolvedor Java experiente e com conhecimentos em Amazon Web Services (AWS) para se juntar à nossa equipe de tecnologia. O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações robustas e escaláveis em Java, integrando-as com serviços na nuvem AWS.
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com Java 8/ 11+, incluindo frameworks como Spring, Spring boot, Hibernate ou Java EE. Proficiência em AWS, com experiência prática em serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, IAM, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, SSM entre outros. Conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços e práticas de desenvolvimento orientado a serviços (SOA). Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (por exemplo, PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB). Familiaridade com ferramentas de CI/CD e automação, como Jenkins, GitLab CI ou AWS CodePipeline. Conhecimento em containers e orquestração, como Docker, EKS e Kubernetes. Experiência com práticas de DevOps e infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando ferramentas como Terraform ou AWS CloudFormation. Habilidade para resolver problemas complexos de forma eficiente e colaborativa. Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas relacionadas. Diferenciais: Certificações AWS, como AWS Certified Developer ou AWS Certified Solutions Architect. Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban). Conhecimento em segurança na nuvem e boas práticas de proteção de dados. Experiência em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful. Contribuições para projetos open source ou participação em comunidades técnicas.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência com OmniStudio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;
  • Conhecimento em Business Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;
  • Experiência com Orchestration Management (OM), incluindo decomposição de pedidos e desenvolvimento de planos de orquestração para processos complexos e multi-step;
  • Conhecimento em Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) será considerado um diferencial, especialmente para gerenciar contratos ao longo de seu ciclo de vida, da criação à renovação e fechamento;


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

title: Engenheiro de API Gateway Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos colaborando com uma empresa portuguesa de referência no setor do varejo , presente em Portugal e Espanha. Neste contexto, procuramos alguém com energia, responsabilidade e motivação para assumir a função de ENGENHEIRO DE API GATEWAY , numa das iniciativas que estamos a conduzir com este cliente.

Neste projeto, a pessoa que se juntar ao time irá trabalhar remotamente com colegas da FCamara e do Cliente baseados em Portugal.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Esta pessoa terá como responsabilidade assegurar que as plataformas de API Gateway do Cliente estão disponíveis e configuradas adequadamente para que os serviços de integração funcionem com alta disponibilidade, performance e segurança.


Requisitos e qualificações

Para esta posição, procuramos alguém com experiência em funções semelhantes.

Você é a pessoa certa se atender estes requisitos obrigatórios :

  • Conhecimento no setup e utilização de soluções de API/Event Gateway + API/Event Management (Apigee, Kong, Gravitee, etc.);
  • Experiência com Git e pipelines CI/CD (Argo CD, Github Actions, etc.);
  • Experiência na utilização de plataformas de observabilidade;


e iremos olhar com muito bons olhos se também atender estes requisitos valorizados

  • Experiência em ambientes com elevado volume de transações e integrações

Para além do conhecimento técnico, também esperamos que tenhas um perfil de colaboração e trabalho em equipe :

  • Capacidade para compreender os requisitos e as soluções técnicas
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação
  • Espírito crítico e foco na melhoria contínua
  • Forte orientação para a entrega e cumprimento de prazos e objetivos

Informações adicionais

Esta é uma posição Full Remote , atuando com equipes do Cliente baseados em Portugal e é específica para quem reside no Brasil (em qualquer cidade ou estado).

Esta posição está inserida num projeto de longa duração .

Idiomas: Nesta posição, o trabalho decorre em língua portuguesa . Inglês será valorizado, especialmente para interações em contexto internacional.

Modelo de Contratação: Temos flexibilidade no modelo de contratação. A nossa equipe de recrutamento fornecerá todos os detalhes e informações sobre o tipo de contrato, remuneração e benefícios, ajustados à tua localização e situação profissional.

Nacionalidade, Residência e Visto: Esta posição não contempla apoio, por parte da FCamara, na obtenção de visto ou autorização de residência para Portugal ou qualquer outro país.

title: Product Designer
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.


Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Product Designer
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.


Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

title: Frontend Developer
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.

Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life

We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience

Experience a community of change makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.

About the Role:


  • Role: Front End Engineer
  • Location: Remote (Brazil)
  • Employment Type: Contract


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize web interfaces using ReactJS
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality features
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices in UI development
  • Ensure responsive design and seamless performance across devices
  • Troubleshoot and resolve UI issues throughout development lifecycle

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience with ReactJS :
  • Mid-Level: 3–4 years of hands-on ReactJS experience
  • Senior: 5+ years of hands-on ReactJS experience
  • Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) , HTML5, CSS3, and related front-end tools
  • Experience with state management (Redux, Context API, etc.)
  • Knowledge of version control (Git) and agile development methodologies
  • Must currently be actively working with ReactJS technologies

title: Analista de Relacionamento com Comunidades - Programas de Reassentamento
description:
Sobre a Synap:


A Synap é uma consultoria especializada em engenharia, planejamento de mina e gestão socioambiental para projetos de mineração em fases críticas de decisão, estruturação e implantação.


Nosso diferencial está na integração prática entre engenharia, operação e gestão social, combinando rigor técnico com sensibilidade social para transformar estudos e planos em projetos viáveis, executáveis e socialmente sustentáveis. Atuamos fortemente em programas de reassentamento, aquisição de terras, relacionamento comunitário, licenciamento e ESG, sempre com foco na mitigação de riscos, previsibilidade da implantação e geração de valor de longo prazo.


Descrição da vaga:

Estamos buscando um(a) Analista de Relacionamento com Comunidades para atuar em contrato temporário , apoiando a execução de programas de aquisição de terras, reassentamento e relacionamento comunitário em projetos do setor de mineração.


O(a) profissional atuará no relacionamento com comunidades e famílias potencialmente afetadas, apoio às atividades de campo e organização das informações sociais, sempre alinhado(a) às boas práticas socioambientais e aos princípios de direitos humanos.


Modelo de trabalho: remoto, com visitas pontuais de campo

⏳ Tipo de contrato: temporário


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar a execução de Planos de Aquisição de Terras e Reassentamento (PAR).
  • Atuar no relacionamento direto com comunidades e famílias , realizando atendimentos, acompanhamentos e registros de interações.
  • Apoiar atividades de engajamento comunitário , reuniões presenciais e remotas.
  • Organizar, atualizar e sistematizar bases de dados sociais, cadastros e registros de atendimento.
  • Apoiar a elaboração de relatórios técnicos, notas de campo, atas e materiais de devolutiva.
  • Atuar em conformidade com diretrizes socioambientais aplicáveis , com atenção a diversidade, equidade, inclusão e direitos humanos.
  • Apoiar a equipe técnica da Synap na interface com clientes.


Requisitos:

  • Formação em Ciências Sociais, Serviço Social, Geografia, Antropologia, Administração, Gestão Ambiental ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência prévia em relacionamento com comunidades
  • Vivência em projetos sociais ou socioambientais
  • Boa comunicação, organização e escuta ativa
  • Disponibilidade para viagens


Será considerando como diferencial:

  • Experiência ou familiaridade com programas de reassentamento involuntário
  • Conhecimento básico dos Padrões de Desempenho do IFC , especialmente PS5
  • Experiência em projetos de mineração


O que oferecemos:

  • Flexibilidade de trabalho remoto
  • Atuação em projetos relevantes e de alto impacto social
  • Ambiente técnico, colaborativo e comprometido com boas práticas ESG
  • Remuneração compatível com a posição

title: Arquiteto(a) em Soluções SAP SuccessFactors BTP
description:
• Gerenciar todo o ciclo de vida das soluções propostas, desde o desenho e desenvolvimento até o acompanhamento da entrega.
  • Estimar custos e esforços para novas soluções e projetos complexos de implantação.
  • Demonstrar conhecimento avançado em SAP HCM SuccessFactors e domínio técnico de soluções BTP/SCPI (Integration Suite).
  • Desenvolver extensões no SAP BTP (CAP) utilizando Node.js aplicando boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Liderar a estratégia e execução de desenvolvimentos, garantindo aderência às melhores práticas (Clean Core, Microserviços, arquitetura orientada a APIs).
  • Implementar integrações standard do SAP SuccessFactors (BIB, Infoporter, Point-to-Point, MDI, IDoc, ALE).
  • Construir integrações complexas com SAP Integration Suite, ABAP, APIs REST/OData, SAP Gateway, OAuth 2.0, SAML e Webservices SOAP.
  • Desenvolver APIs customizadas para SAP ECP e S/4HANA, garantindo segurança e performance.
  • Garantir segurança, escalabilidade e governança das integrações, incluindo monitoramento e troubleshooting.
  • Definir padrões técnicos para extensões e integrações, promovendo arquitetura sustentável e alinhada às estratégias corporativas.


Requisitos :

  • Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Administração, ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência como Arquiteto SAP SuccessFactors em projetos de implementação.
  • Experiência na implementação de integrações standard (BIB, Point-to-Point, Infoporter, MDI, ALE, IDoc).
  • Conhecimento avançado em SAP HCM SuccessFactors, SAP Integration Suite, ABAP HCM, APIs REST/OData, SAP Gateway e SAP BTP.
  • Proficiência em desenvolvimento no SAP BTP (CAP) com Node.js.
  • Experiência com monitoramento e troubleshooting (SAP Cloud Integration Monitor).
  • Certificações SAP BTP, SuccessFactors ou TOGAF serão consideradas diferenciais.

Desejável:

  • Conhecimento em SAP PI/PO, SAP ALM, SAP Fiori e práticas de governança de APIs.
  • Experiência com CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins, Cloud Foundry).
  • Familiaridade com LGPD/GDPR e segurança de dados.
  • Inglês avançado.
